Fixture for ci/secrets-selftest.sh. Every rule in .gitleaks.toml is exercised
here by at least one sample that must be caught, and the ways each rule is
meant NOT to fire are exercised by samples that must be ignored.

Two rules of the road for editing this file:

  - Every value below is synthetic or a published test vector. No real host,
    address, account or person appears here, and none may be added. The point
    of the file is the SHAPE.
  - Adding a sample means updating the expected counts in
    ci/secrets-selftest.sh, which fails on any mismatch in either direction —
    a rule that stops matching and a rule that starts over-matching are both
    regressions, and only the first one announces itself.

The negatives matter more than the positives. A rule that has quietly stopped
matching still passes any test that only asks "did anything fire", which is the
failure mode this whole gate was built to close.

  /var/home/jdoe/.config/pql/config.yaml

  /mnt/storage/projects/another-thing/README.md

pql-nl-bsn
  One sample per keyword branch. The rule is an alternation, and a fixture that
  exercises a single branch stays green while the others are dead — observed,
  not theorised: one branch was mutated and the selftest did not notice, because
  only a different branch had a sample.
  NOTE: prose in this file is scanned too. Do not write a rule's keyword in a
  comment, or the comment becomes a phantom match that keeps the count correct
  while the branch it describes is broken. That happened here first.
  bsn 123456782
  burgerservicenummer 123456782
  sofinummer 123456782

pql-personal-email
  someone@gmail.com

=== MUST BE IGNORED ===

carries an allowlist rather than a narrower regex.

  /home/runner/work/pql/pql

Documentation addresses, as distinct from a real host on a real subnet.
  192.168.1.1

Reserved SSN groups that are never issued.
  000-12-3456
  666-12-3456
  123-00-6789
  123-45-0000

Identifiers this repo emits constantly. A ULID is 26 uppercase alphanumerics
and an IBAN pattern must not swallow one; the changelog is full of both these
and MD5 row hashes, so a false positive here would fire on every ticket commit
and get the gate switched off within a week.
  06G1RZ3FETE52W7K24P68S9K3C
  8ad2510e8c8523f6c35efa5eb83f16c7

A bare 9-digit run with no BSN keyword nearby. The keyword scoping is what
makes that rule usable at all — order numbers, row counts and timestamps are
all 9-ish digits.
